Licence conflict resolved by the deposit's corresponding author by email on 2026-09-21, copying the first author: they confirmed that the Zenodo metadata licence (CC BY 4.0) is the one they intend, and that the README's CC BY-NC-ND line was an unintentional default they can no longer edit. The correspondence itself is private and a reader cannot verify it - see data/SOURCES.md. README as fetched still states: 'THIS DATASET IS PUBLICALLY AVAILABLE UNDER A CREATIVE COMMONS CC BY-NC-ND LICENSE (ATTRIBUTION-NONCOMMERCIAL-NODERIVS)'
